submitted.rationale: EQE rises steadily as Sb decreases: 0.029% (Sb 0.81), 0.028% (0.68), 0.093% (0.42), 0.140% (0.33), 0.287% (0.236). Index 1 had the highest measured EQE. Within the XRD range (Sb 0.22–0.45), only the FTO SnO2 substrate peaks appear, except for a new reflection near Q=2.44 at Sb 0.45 that may come from the trirutile ZnSb2O6 phase. This suggests the Zn-rich films are poorly crystalline, and that Zn-rich films perform best for 3.2 eV illumination.
